capabilities: Chat with LLM providers via a streaming chat panel with Markdown rendering
Inject relevant vault notes as context using TF-IDF RAG and embedding search with RRF ranking
Attach notes as context and let the LLM read or propose edits to vault files
Run quick actions (summarize, translate, proofread, explain, expand) on selected text
Save, browse, resume, and delete past conversations
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; beta versions can be installed via BRAT. Requires Obsidian v1.11.4+ for SecretStorage key storage. A previous plugin ID (obsidian-llm-assistant) requires renaming the plugin folder when migrating. Google Gemini offers a free tier and Ollama runs locally without an API key.
motivation: The author found existing Obsidian LLM plugins feature-heavy with cluttered UI, small prompt and output areas, and poor mobile support, so built this with a simple chat UI, full-platform support, multi-provider access, secure key storage, and RAG-based note retrieval.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and per the author many existing LLM plugins have cluttered interfaces, cramped input/output areas, and often do not work on iPhone or iPad.

summary: Chat panel for multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama) with RAG vault search, note context, and text quick actions.
